name: solarabase_query
description: Ask a natural-language question and get an LLM-synthesized answer grounded in the Solarabase knowledge base. Returns the answer plus the reasoning_path and tools_used the server applied. Use this when you want Solarabase to do retrieval AND synthesis for you; use solarabase_retrieve instead when you want the raw passages to reason over and cite yourself.

question.description: The natural-language question to answer from the knowledge base (1-32000 characters)
